reviewed.ownership: Final InternalTexture owner release is observed; shared refs>1 keep their live decode. releaseMapTexture sequential disposal and abandoned WeakSet still enforce exact late GPU allocation guard.
reviewed.defaultsAndCache: Supervisor posts the current job defaults before each dispatch. Cache keys include public defaults+caps+input options; private owner Symbol remains on options until decode boundary but is excluded from cache key and worker structured clone. Warm cache bypasses the worker; the exact _createTexture abandoned-owner guard still executes.
reviewed.failures: Initialization/channel/worker/post/active deadline faults drain original and queued jobs once, remove worker listeners and latch failure; bad image decode rejects only its job. Late messages from an old lease fail identity guard.
reviewed.lifetime: 45-second total per decode includes queue/init/active stages. Same-turn cancellation deferred pump prevents old batch worker churn. Idle lease retires after1s. Explicit initializeVillageKtx2 on next map setup recovers only the failure latch.
reviewed.sdkCompatibility: Official SDK workerFunction/applyConfig/init used. Existing external pools/workerless runtime preserved. Actual shipped ETC1S test compares all9mips byte-for-byte with native SDK and proves warm cache hit.

limitations: No actual browser scheduler or GPU/device thermal measurement.
A45s total limit may also reject a legitimately slow first8K decode; queued/init/active diagnostic times distinguish this.
Physical worker termination stops that owned worker but cannot preempt synchronous main-thread execution.
A pre-existing external pool is preserved and reported, not repaired by this supervisor.
